content: Ola brabli gudwan wed
Wal dislot na ola brabli gudwan wed blanga Salaman hubin det san blanga Deibid, en hubin det king blanga Isreil.

Wal Salaman bin tok, “Ol yumob, dislot brabli gudwan wed na garra album yumob blanga sabi mowa en jinggabat streitbalawei blanga dum gudbala ting. Olabat garra album yumob sabi gudbalawei en meigim yumob jidan garram streitwan main.
Olabat na garra album yumob blanga sabi mowa en jidan gudbalawei. Olabat garra titjim yumob hau blanga jidan trubalawei, en hau blanga gibit feyago en blanga jidan raitwei.

Sambala langa yumob nomo sabi enijing, bat dislot brabli gudwan wed na garra album yumob blanga sabi mowa hau blanga jidan gudbalawei en album ola yang pipul blanga teiknodis en lenimbat ola gudbala ting.
Sambala yumob klebawan pipul garra kipgon lenlenbat, wulijim yumob garra len mowa. Sambala yumob pipul sabi ebrijing. Wal yumob garra len mowa en faindat ola brabli gudwan wed iya na,
wulijim yumob garra sabi ola raitwan mining blanga detlot gudwan wed en detlot kwestjan weya detlot pipul hu sabi ebrijing toktokbat gija.
“If yumob wandim jidan sabibala, yumob garra abum rispek en teiknodis langa YAWEI det trubala God basdam. Bat ol detlot silibala pipul nomo laigim len en sabi enijing.” Lagijat na Salaman bin tok.
Sambala sabibala tok dijan langa biginini
“Wal main biginini, yu garra lisin langa yu mami en dedi, wanim dubala dalimbat yu.

Jis laik wen yu peintap en yu werrimon det tjein langa yu nek blanga meigim yu luk brabli purdiwan, wal detlot wed blanga yu mami en dedi im lagijat du wen yu lisin en teiknodis. Im garra meigim yu jidan gudbalawei.”
Nomo bulurrum nogudbala pipul
“Main biginini, wen nogudbala pipul temtimbat yu blanga dum nogudbala ting, yu kaan bulurrum olabat.
Wal maitbi olabat garra tok langa yu, ‘Yu wandim kaman langa melabat? Wi garra go blanga kilim sambodi ded. Wi kilim enibodi eniwei.
Nomeda im jidan laibala tudei, bat wi garra kilim im ded.
En brom deya wi garra go langa im haus en gajim olkain gudbala ting en wi garra bilimap wi haus garram detlot ting weya wibin stilimbat.
Yu kaman garram melabat en wi garra sherimat ola ebrijing weya wibin stilimbat.’ Lagijat na olabat garra tok langa yu.
“Main biginini, yu nomo bulurrum detkain pipul en yu nomo dum wanim olabat oldei dumbat.
Olabat oldei wandim dumbat nogudbala ting en dei oldei jidan redi blanga kilim enibodi.
Im nogud blanga spredimat det net wen ola bard yu wandi gajim dei lukinatbat yu,
bat detkain pipul hu dumbat nogudbala ting garra trepam olabat ronselp en olabat garra dai.
Wen yu kilim sambodi blanga stilimbat im enijing, wal det nogudbalawei na garra binijimap yu laif.”
Det sabibalawan im jinginat
Det brabli sabibalawan im jis laik det wuman hu oldei jinginatbat langa ebri roud langa det taun en langa detlot pleis weya pipul oldei go blanga baiyim enijing.
Im oldei jinginatbat adbala langa detlot taun geit en langa ola pleis weya pipul midap.
Wal im tok, “Ol yumob silibala pipul, haulong yumob garra jidan lagijat? Haulong yumob garra dumbat detkain ting en meigimbat fan langa mi? Wotfo yumob nomo len blanga dum gudbala ting?
Yumob lisin gudwei na wanim ai garra dalim yumob. Ai garra dalimbat yumob gudwan wed weya ai sabi.
Aibin oldei jinginat langa yumob, bat yumob nomo bin lisin langa mi, najing. Aibin trai pudumat main bingga, bat yumob nomo bin teiknodis, najing.
Yumob nomo bin teiknodis langa main wed. Yumob nomo wandim mi blanga dalim yumob hau blanga jidan raitwei.
“Wal bambai ai garra laflaf langa yumob wen yumob garra abum trabul, en ai garra meigimbat fan langa yumob wen nogudbala ting garra hepin langa yumob.
Det brabli nogudbala ting garra kaman langa yumob wulijim bigiswan rein. Det trabul garra kaman langa yumob jis laik det wiliwili, en yumob garra abum loda pein en yumob garra nogudbinji nomo lilbit.
Bambai na yumob garra jingat langa mi blanga album yumob, bat ai kaan ensim yumob. En yumob garra lukabat blanga mi, bat yumob kaan faindim mi.
Yumob nomo bin wandim len blanga det sabibalawei brom mi en yumob nomo bin teiknodis langa YAWEI.
Yumob nomo bin lisin en teiknodis langa main wed. Yumob nomo bin laigim dum ola rait ting wen aibin dalimbat yumob.
Wal yumob garra faindat wanim garra hepin langa yumob. Yumob garra abum trabul. En detlot nogudwan plen weya yumob bin meigimbat blanga najalot pipul garra kambek langa yumob igin.
“Wal ola pipul hu nomo sabi enijing garra gitkil, dumaji dei nomo lisin langa ola gudwan wed en dei nomo wandim dum ola gudbala ting.

Bat detlot pipul hu lisin gudwei langa mi garra jidan gudbalawei langa seifwan pleis. Nomo enijing kaan ardimbat olabat na en dei kaan bradin blanga enijing.” Lagijat na det brabli sabibalawan bin tok.
